title: Spanakopita-Style Spinach and Feta Bake
subtitle: A Greek-inspired bake with spinach, feta, dill, and a rough pastry top
excerpt: This is a simplified version of the Greek classic. Instead of filo pastry, a rough flour-and-butter sheet goes on top, baking into a short, flaky crust. The filling of wilted spinach and crumbled feta is the same as the original.
sourceNotes: Spanakopita is a staple of Greek cuisine, found throughout the country in bakeries and homes. This version adapts it for home cooks without access to filo pastry.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze before baking. Cook from frozen at the same temperature, adding 15 minutes.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: The filling can be made a day ahead and refrigerated. Add the pastry top just before baking.

content.text: The most important step is squeezing the wilted spinach very thoroughly. Any excess water in the filling will make the base wet and the pastry soggy.
Preheat the oven. Wilt the spinach in batches in a dry saucepan over medium heat. Tip into a colander and press out as much water as possible with the back of a spoon. Chop roughly.
In a large bowl, mix the spinach, feta, beaten eggs, spring onion, dill, nutmeg, and olive oil. Season with black pepper only (feta is salty).
Tip the filling into a greased baking dish (about 22cm x 28cm).
Make the pastry top: rub the cold butter into the flour until it resembles breadcrumbs. Add 3 tablespoons of cold water and mix briefly into a rough dough.
Press or roll the pastry to roughly fit the top of the dish. Lay it over the filling. Press the edges lightly against the dish sides. Score a few times with a knife to let steam escape.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes until the pastry is golden and the filling is set. Rest for 5 minutes before cutting.

items.symptom: The base of the bake is wet and watery.
items.cause: The spinach was not squeezed dry enough.
items.fix: Use a clean cloth to twist and wring spinach next time.

items.symptom: The pastry top is pale and soft.
items.cause: The oven was not fully preheated.
items.fix: Return to the oven for 10 minutes and check again.

items.cause: Salt was added on top of the feta.
items.fix: Always taste before adding salt; feta provides most of the seasoning.
